result.summary: The page looks mostly intact, but the bottom navigation bar is overlapping the content area, causing the last restaurant card to be partially hidden. A few horizontally scrollable items are also clipped at the edges, though those may be intentional carousels.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar covers part of the restaurant list, obscuring the lower card content near the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so items are not hidden behind the fixed tab bar.

issues.description: Several cards/chips are partially cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: If these are scrollable carousels, make the horizontal scroll affordance clearer; otherwise adjust spacing so important text is fully visible.
